title: US Senate Passes Graham Russia Sanctions Act 86–11, Honoring Late Senator
detail: The US Senate approved the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 by a final vote of 86–11, authorizing President Trump to impose tariffs of up to 200% on major purchasers of Russian oil and gas and expanding sanctions on Russian financial institutions, political elites, and the shadow fleet. The bill carries the name of Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died July 11 — a day after announcing the deal with the White House and shortly after returning from Kyiv, reportedly of an aortic tear. Zelensky called the vote 'a big signal' of American commitment, writing: 'We are very grateful to the US Senate and to everyone who supports Ukraine.' The bill still requires House passage before reaching Trump's desk.

media.caption: The late Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-SC), namesake of the Russia sanctions act passed by the Senate 86-11
